thesis.title: "Lorenz-1960 PINN: Solving the ODE System from the Equations Alone"
thesis.quote: "Can a neural network solve a differential equation from the equations alone? Our PINN trains on the ODE residual, never sees the answer, and lands within 3e-05 of a high-accuracy reference."
thesis.methodology: A PINN with a hard-constrained initial condition, trained on the ODE residual alone and validated against SciPy DOP853, plus a nine-architecture sweep and a windowed causal-weighting study for longer horizons.
thesis.outcomes: FYDP-II defended and the manuscript submitted to ICEEICT 2027. Sixteen paper runs and sixteen windowed models are archived with SHA-256 verification, backed by 41 tests.
